lines.zh: 我的蛇发扫过地面，声音很轻。
lines.en: My snake hair sweeps the ground almost without a sound.
The venom sacs on my back sway with every step.
I still walk like the witch I used to be.
Every step adds a little more toxin.

lines.zh: 我绕你转圈，数你的空隙。
lines.en: I circle you and count the gaps in your guard.
A slick trail of my ooze stays behind me.
Do not rush me; six points are not gathered yet.
My shadow is crowned with snake heads.
Come closer; I cannot see you clearly.
Slow steps; the toxin keeps growing.
The grass blackens wherever I tread.
I creep along the marsh edge at my own pace.
Another sac on my back swells a notch.
I count my toxin points: one, two, three.
At six points I can loose the beam.

lines.zh: 女巫的坩埚还在记忆里。
lines.en: The witch's cauldron still steams in my memory.
My snakes sniff the air on my behalf.
I lick the bitter sap from my lips.
Spores sprout between my fingers.

lines.zh: 别出声，我在听你的心跳。
lines.en: Stay quiet; I am listening to your heartbeat.
My venom sacs itch, which means they are near full.
I am patient; the light will come on its own.

lines.zh: 这顶破帽子还是女巫的。
lines.en: This ragged hat still belonged to the witch.
I smear venom under my tongue.
A rabbit trembles somewhere far off.
In the silence, the spores grow.

lines.zh: 我把手指按进土里，菌丝散开。
lines.en: I press my fingers into the soil and mycelium spreads.

lines.zh: 我数背后的囊，一共五个鼓的。
lines.en: I count the sacs on my back: five are swollen.

lines.zh: 我慢慢吐气，空气里有甜味。
lines.en: I exhale slowly, and the air turns sweet.

lines.zh: 女巫的咒我忘了半句，也不急。
lines.en: I forget half the witch's spell, and I do not mind.
You bring your face this close to mine?
Do not look away; watch the snakes.

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔在数你的睫毛。
lines.en: My pupils are counting your eyelashes.
Your eyes reflect the sacs on my back.

lines.zh: 看久了会石化的，传说如此。
lines.en: Legend says a long look turns you to stone.

lines.zh: 你的鼻息吹到我的蛇信。
lines.en: Your breath reaches my forked tongues.

lines.zh: 我认得这种眼神，是想跑。
lines.en: I know that look; it means you want to run.

lines.zh: 抬头，让我看清你的脖子。
lines.en: Lift your head so I can see your throat.
Do you want to become a witch too?

lines.zh: 你的睫毛在抖，我看得清。
lines.en: Your lashes tremble, and I see every one.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的毒囊上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls across my venom sacs.
Look your fill, then go; I keep no guests.
Cut me? The venom in my sacs quickens.
It hurts, but my six points still stand.

lines.zh: 伤口冒出的不是血，是孢子。
lines.en: What leaves the wound is spores, not blood.
The snakes recoil once, then reach again.
You sheared off one of my snake locks.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起自己还是女巫。
lines.en: This blow reminds me I was a witch.
My hide took most of that.

lines.zh: 别停手，我要看清你的招式。
lines.en: Do not stop; I want to learn your swing.
Blood runs to my feet and the grass withers.

lines.zh: 囊被震得发酸，我缓一缓。
lines.en: The sacs ache from the shock; give me a moment.
A witch does not eat bread; she brews.

lines.zh: 把胡萝卜换成毒蘑菇试试。
lines.en: Try offering a poison mushroom instead of carrots.

lines.zh: 我背后那六个点才是食物。
lines.en: The six points on my back are what I feed.
You hold out rotten flesh like feeding a dog.
Food never reaches my stomach.
Lure me with food? I have potions.
Swallow it; that much is not enough.
I taste poison, not sweetness.
Put it down, then take three steps back.
Whatever you hold is going moldy.
Do not shove me; the sacs may spill.
You brushed against one of my snakes.
Back off; this patch of ground is mine.
Pressing in, hoping to be bitten?
My bones are harder than dead branches.
You knocked a scale off me.

lines.zh: 再碰，我就把毒抹你身上。
lines.en: Touch me again and the venom is on you.
Is bumping into me your greeting?
I smell iron on your sleeve.
Give me room; snakes hate being crowded.

lines.zh: 女巫不需要伴侣，只需要坩埚。
lines.en: A witch needs no mate, only a cauldron.
Breeding? I prefer distilling.

lines.zh: 我的孩子从囊里长出来。
lines.en: My children grow out of the sacs.
Kin of my kind trade venom, nothing else.
A mate would choke on my toxin.
One of me in this world is enough.
Mating is slow; spores are faster.
Asking that — are you offering?
My eggs are six venom sacs.
Go away; in season I bite.

lines.zh: 我捡东西？手都用来抓你了。
lines.en: Pick things up? My hands are for grabbing you.
That potion on the ground is mine.
Leave it; that is a witch's relic.
I only pick up what can be brewed.

lines.zh: 掉落的骨头我留着做引子。
lines.en: I keep dropped bones as a starter.
What did you drop? Let me smell it.

lines.zh: 这朵蘑菇比你的剑有用。
lines.en: This mushroom is more useful than your sword.
I cannot bend; the sacs are too heavy.
Scavenging is an old witch habit.
I want that string; do not step on it.
Your blood smells warm from here.
Six points gathered — I begin with you.
Do not run; the toxin is already at your feet.
Your footsteps slipped two beats.
The witch's curse knows your name.
You trampled my mushroom ring.
The sacs are swelling; can you hear them?
Today's specimen has finally shown up.
That armor will not stop the spores.
I choose you because you are panting.
Every snake turns its head toward you.

lines.zh: 我在量你到毒囊的距离。
lines.en: I am measuring the gap to my venom sacs.
My sacs hiss like boiling water.

lines.zh: 蛇信已经够到你的鞋尖。
lines.en: My forked tongue already reaches your boot tip.
The light is coming; stand firm.

lines.zh: 六点差一点，你正好赶上。
lines.en: Six points, almost full; you arrived on time.
Six points full; the beam leaves its chamber.
Your breathing is uneven; good.
I have you ringed inside my snakes.
This time I will not miss.
My claws scrape across your armor.

lines.zh: 八点伤害，够你记一会儿。
lines.en: Eight points of damage; enough to remember.
The snakes bite first, then my hand.
My claws graze across your shoulder.
Venom works its way into the wound.

lines.zh: 这一掌用了女巫的力气。
lines.en: This blow carries a witch's strength.
Got you; stop struggling.
My nails are curved like hooks.
The blood on your face is fresh.
Come closer; I want a second swipe.

lines.zh: 坩埚翻了，我从中站起来。
lines.en: The cauldron tipped, and I rose out of it.
The witch died; I keep living.
My sacs swelled, and I woke.

lines.zh: 沼泽的雾替我遮住出身。
lines.en: The marsh mist hides where I came from.
Six points, and I start counting from zero.
A seam split open inside the mushroom ring.
I smell the world of the living.

lines.zh: 背上多了重量，也多了牙。
lines.en: My back grew heavier, and grew teeth.

lines.zh: 谁把我从土里挖出来的？
lines.en: Who dug me out of the soil?

lines.zh: 旧的咒语还在我骨头上。
lines.en: The old curse still clings to my bones.
Spores fall first; I follow after.

lines.zh: 这具身体是新的，恨是旧的。
lines.en: This body is new; the grudge is old.
Fire on snake hair smells foul.
My sacs slammed together on landing.

lines.zh: 水灌进蛇嘴里，咳不出来。
lines.en: Water fills my snakes' mouths and will not leave.
The blast left my venom sacs numb.
The arrow sits between sac and bone.

lines.zh: 附魔的光在我身上打滑。
lines.en: The enchanted light slides off my hide.
Hunger has stilled even my snakes.
Lightning struck; every snake lock stood upright.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有草，也没有坩埚。
lines.en: The void has no grass and no cauldron.
